newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Marcopolo starts as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Marcopolo starts as hold.

text.p: -- Credit Lyonnais said on Thursday it had started coverage of Brazilian bus frame maker Marcopolo SA Carroceria e Onibus with a rating of hold.
-- "The Mexican crisis and the strong real (currency) ... have strongly reduced profitability of Marcopolo's exports," analyst Evandro Pereira wrote in a report.
-- "The company has been shifting production to the domestic market, where tough competition and sluggish demand have been pushing prices down."
-- He estimated a 12.8 percent decline in 1997 earnings as a result of declining sales.
-- "Despite its top quality management and its worldwide competitiveness, we believe that these valuations imply little upside potential on Marcopolo's shares ...," Pereira said.
